那些丝线，无穷无尽……它们扭动着，我拉扯，我撕扯，可编织纹丝不动！这具可憎的皮囊我还要忍受多久？还要剥落多少层，才能窥见其中真谛？
texts.en:
As our population swells, Kronen the Afflicted grows ever more frenzied. Their voice quivers with strain, their form twitching, rippling, flesh in flux as they rasp in frustration.

The strands, endless... they writhe, I pull, I tear, yet the weave holds! How much longer must I endure this wretched shape? How much more must I shed before the pattern reveals itself?

responses.zh: 问题？单数？哈，多么天真。我每撕去一丝，我们每扯断一缕闪亮的细线，那些丝线只会缠得更紧！而自始至终，生命之织缕都在哼唱着它那令人作呕、直击内脏的旋律……
responses.en: Problem? Singular? Oh, how quaint. Every shred I slough away, every glistening strand we tear, the threads only tighten! And all the while, the Composer of Strands hums its sickening, visceral melody...

responses.zh:
问题？单数？哈，多么天真。我每撕去一丝，我们每扯断一缕闪亮的细线，那些丝线只会缠得更紧！而自始至终，生命之织缕都在哼唱着它那令人作呕、直击内脏的旋律……

克罗南剧烈地抽搐着。那只独眼翻白，皮下血肉脉动、翻涌，随后突然……静止。这荒诞扭结的重组如同其开始时一样骤然停止。

啊……你好。需要什么吗？
responses.en:
Problem? Singular? Oh, how quaint. Every shred I slough away, every glistening strand we tear, the threads only tighten! And all the while, the Composer of Strands hums its sickening, visceral melody...

Kronen convulses violently. Their lone eye rolls back, flesh pulsing, bubbling beneath the surface, then, suddenly... stillness. The grotesque restructuring halts as abruptly as it began.

Ah... hello. Did you need something?

responses.zh: 休息？不，永不。我们绝不能停滞不前，绝不能让这具可悲的肉体在平庸中腐朽。我不需要休息……我需要实验对象。需要可塑的材料，需要雕琢的素材，需要蜕变的根基。
responses.en: A break? No, never. We must not stagnate, must not let this wretched flesh rot in mediocrity. I don't need rest... I need subjects. I need material to mold, to sculpt, to become.

label.en: Can we do anything to help?

responses.zh:
你能提醒我……我曾是什么模样吗？告诉我，当我们初次交谈时，我的肢体始终是这种颜色吗？我的角膜曾这般浑浊吗？每当试图回忆，我的血肉就在这条路上陷得更深。

不……记忆在此毫无价值。启示藏于变化本身。对生命之织缕而言，过往已毫无意义。退下吧。我必须……思考。
responses.en:
Can you remind me... what I was? Tell me, when we first spoke, were my appendages always this color? Was my cornea ever this clouded? Each time I try to remember, my flesh shifts further along the path.

No... memory has no value here. Revelation lies in the change itself. What came before means nothing to the Composer of Strands now. Leave me. I must... think.

responses.zh:
当然。我为何不该如此？这些丝缕进一步开拓了我的思维，将这具低效的血肉之躯重塑，以更契合生命之织缕的设计。现在，请恕我失陪……还有如此多的线头需要梳理。如此多的躯壳亟待抛弃。

当通讯终止时，一阵共鸣在虚境中嗡鸣。无论此刻笼罩克罗南的灾厄为何……都绝非偶然。此乃生命之织缕的意志
responses.en:
Of course. Why wouldn't I be? The strands have opened my mind even further, reshaped this inefficient flesh to better fit the Composer of Strands's design. Now, if you'll excuse me... there are still so many threads to pull. So many husks to leave behind.

As the transmission ends, a resonance hums across the Shroud. Whatever affliction grips Kronen now... it is no accident. It is the will of the Composer of Strands.

label.zh: 织缕之主的馈赠不可等闲视之。
label.en: A gift from the Composer should not be taken lightly.
